SongComments.SongComment: Here's a quick technique to get perfectly beat-synced wobbles.

In this example I'm using a Hydra connected to a Gainer and lowpass Filter to change the bass sound. You could easily connect other devices and effects to the Hydra in order to get a more interesting sound. I leave that up to you :)
Usage:
- The Shape LFO controls the shape of the wobble.
You can change this LFO to a different mode, or draw your
own custom envelope to easily change the characteristics.
- The Key Tracker resets the Shape LFO with each note.
This ensures that each wobble is perfectly synced to each
note you play. If you prefer your wobbles to be more loose
and drift around a bit more, you could disable this and
then simply reset the Shape LFO once at the start of each
pattern instead.
- The Speed LFO controls the speed of the Shape LFO.
This uses a custom envelope that I programmed by hand, to
perfectly match the LFO speed to some useful musical
timings. To change the wobble speed, you should reset the
Speed LFO at different points in your pattern. I've
included a reference table of reset command values below.
- Speed LFO reset command values: (Assumes 4 Lines/Beat)
x800 = 2/1 x810 = 2/1 triplet x820 = 2/1 dotted
x830 = 1/1 x840 = 1/1 triplet x850 = 1/1 dotted
x860 = 1/2 x870 = 1/2 triplet x880 = 1/2 dotted
x890 = 1/4 x8A0 = 1/4 triplet x8B0 = 1/4 dotted
x8C0 = 1/8 x8D0 = 1/8 triplet x8E0 = 1/8 dotted
